hypothesis: Classify stderr-only executor failures safely so scheduled operator recovery can distinguish access, quota and connection failures without raw logs.
action: Bounded 8192-character in-memory stderr window mapped to existing fixed categories; window cleared at child close. Compiled local runtime.

verification.controls: Split stderr chunks, usage/authentication/connection/context categories and unknown failure; raw fixture marker absent from status.

limits: No real executor replay or controller launch
No customer path, sale or deployment proof
followUp: Next scheduled executor failure: classified versus unknown category and receipt presence. Do not replay the failed pass solely to measure.

supervisorAcceptance.regressionReproduced: Specific stderr failure was overwritten by a later generic structured event in the initial patch; targeted subprocess control failed before correction.
supervisorAcceptance.correction: Preserve specific structured categories across generic events; use a separate stderr fallback only when structured category is unknown. Successful receipts remain successful regardless of stderr category.
additionalControls: Specific stderr then generic structured failure
Structured category takes priority over stderr
limits: Fixed heuristic categories are diagnostic hints, not proof of the underlying provider failure.
No raw stderr retained, provider replay, Site publication, customer fulfillment or purchase.
